title: David Morales fired the fatal shot from the grassy knoll
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of David Morales fired the fatal shot from the grassy knoll, about 1963 at Dealey Plaza, Dallas, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: They actually the shot that was fired from the null that killed him was was Morales. Uh David Morales

plain: A lawyer and researcher named Dan Sheehan, on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, says he knows who fired the shot that killed President John F. Kennedy in Dealey Plaza, Dallas, in 1963. According to Sheehan, the fatal shot came from the grassy knoll, a small grassy slope beside the motorcade route, and was fired by a man named David Morales. If true, it would mean Kennedy was not killed by a lone gunman.
